description: A data storage for people applying to job portals.
liveAppDelay: First load may take about a minute.
deploymentFirst: This deployment is configured for direct access to the main application.
deploymentSecond: Authentication and authorization are not enforced in the demo deployment, allowing the applicant management interface to be explored directly.
ui: Applicant list with pagination, sorting, and filtering

separation.title: Separation of Concerns
items: Especially separating data and code: contract-first.
Feature-oriented architecture through the directory structure.

source.title: Single Source of Truth
items: Reduce management: updating once updates everywhere.

automation.title: Automation
items: Prefer automation over manually updating, generating, and synchronizing things.

modularity.title: Modularity & Abstraction
items: If something is used in many places, create a package for it.

extraction.title: Extraction
items: Extract mechanisms rather than duplicating them.

readability.title: Readability
items: Use domain/business jargon rather than technology or implementation jargon. Know the customer/stakeholder.
Use self-explanatory function and variable names.

limitations: Only Basic Info is currently implemented; infrastructure exists for other applicant sections.
Authentication and authorization are not implemented.
Applicant profile sections beyond Basic Info are incomplete.
The application is intended as a demonstration/project rather than production hiring platform.
Currently focused on the recruiter and applicant data-management workflow.

The demo runs on free-tier hosting. After a period of inactivity, the first request can take up to a minute while the server wakes up. If data still doesn't load, the database may be powered off, so please contact me.
Deep pages are slower, because the database must skip over earlier rows on each request. Keyset pagination would fix this, but it changes the API.
